name: ai-kb-harness-template
description: Стартовая оснастка для проектов где markdown-репо = knowledge base, а AI-агенты — ежедневный инструмент. Перед использованием: corepack pnpm run setup.

scripts.setup: corepack pnpm -C scripts/semantic install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm -C scripts/skillopt install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm -C tools/viewer install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm -C scripts/whoajor install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.whoajor:verify: corepack pnpm whoajor:verify-spa-surface && corepack pnpm whoajor:verify-published
scripts.kb:check: corepack pnpm agent:test && corepack pnpm agent:check && corepack pnpm viewer:test && node scripts/semantic/test-retrieval.mjs && node scripts/semantic/test-control.mjs && node scripts/semantic/test-gate.mjs && node scripts/kb-doctor.mjs && node scripts/semantic/verify.mjs --scan --provenance --no-semantic
